description: PyLUSAT is a Python GIS toolkit maintained by land-use planning researchers for spatial suitability analysis. It offers distance and density calculations, interpolation, reclassification, spatial joins, zonal statistics and analytic hierarchy processing. A user supplies candidate land areas, criteria layers and weights; outputs are processed factors or suitability maps for the selected study area. Geographic coverage is user-defined and spatial resolution follows the input rasters and features. BSD-3-Clause code, installation guidance and a peer-reviewed methods paper are public. A limitation is that a weighted suitability map expresses chosen criteria, not proving legal, ecological or engineering feasibility; sensitivity to weights should be tested. PyLUSAT can screen sites for energy facilities, flood storage or urban green space before detailed simulation. The catalogue's model-palm-4u-urban-climate is a separate physical urban-climate model, not a land-suitability component. No GIS layer or package was downloaded.
name: PyLUSAT land-use suitability toolkit
